title: ClaudeAgents telemetry outcome.json, v1
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the telemetry/outcome.json artefact written once at run termination. The artefact records the run's terminal disposition, the O2 terminalReason that drove it, the per-sprint outcomes, an aggregate cost rollup (nullable, with an explicit complete:boolean discriminator so a lossy trace cannot silently undercount), summary references to safety halts, and an empty-at-v1.0 humanReviews slot reserved for E6 v1.2's per-sprint human-review records. humanReviews item shape is intentionally unconstrained at v1 so E6 can land its items in place without forcing a v2 bump.

isoDateTimeMs.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision. The pattern enforces the encoding directly so the bundled ajv (strict:true, no ajv-formats) accepts it without relying on format:date-time.

safetyHaltEntry.description: Summary reference to one safety halt; the halt's evidence lives in the T1 trace, this surface only carries the breadcrumbs an outcome reader needs to find it.

costObject.description: Aggregate cost rollup. complete is required and boolean: true when the trace is verified-complete (droppedEmits === 0 at termination), false when at least one R7 emit was dropped and a real number was therefore lost. The six metric fields are non-negative integers summed from the T1 trace via R7's aggregateRunSummary.

items.description: One per-sprint outcome record. status reuses the run-level disposition vocabulary applied per-sprint, with complete substituted for success; that mismatch is deliberate so a per-sprint terminal-success reads as 'this sprint is done' rather than the run-scoped 'this run succeeded'. attemptCounts is a free-shape map of role-id -> attempt count.

humanReviews.description: Reserved-empty at v1.0; E6 v1.2 will land per-sprint human-review records here. The schema intentionally does not pin item shape so E6's items land as an additive in-place edit per F3's additive-stays-on-vN rule rather than forcing a v2 bump.
